"milkV" and "Mars V1.21" are silkscreened on board top. {{See also|StarFive VisionFive|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[StarFive]] JH7110 -U74x4 @1.5GHz :SoC: Quad-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXE-4-32 @600MHz :(OpenGL ES3.2, OpenVG 1.2, Vulkan 1.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp30, :H.265 encoder up to 1080p30 *Storage: 16MB (SPI) Flash (''[[GigaDevice]]''), :TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot, :eMMC module socket *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM (''[[Micron]]'') *Network: 1x GbE ports (w/ PoE support) *PCIe: NGFF M.2 (Key E) socket w/ PCIe 2.0 *USB: 3x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 ports *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V/3A via USB (Type-C) or :5V Power from the GPIO Pin 2 and 4 or :via PoE via PoE expansion header
